name: Checkpoint & Rollback
description: Before destructive file operations (edit, delete, overwrite), saves the original content to ~/.openclaw/checkpoints/ so you can manually restore if needed.

maxCheckpointsPerSession.description: Max checkpoints to save per session (default: 50)

watchTools.description: Tool names to checkpoint before execution (default: str_replace_based_edit_tool, write_file, create_file, edit, create)
